service.en: Green or bulky waste removal from homes
service.ar: إزالة المخلفات الخضراء أو الضخمة من المنازل
service.ur: گھروں سے سبز یا بھاری کچرا ہٹانا
service.ml: വീടുകളിൽ നിന്ന് ഹരിത / വലിയ മാലിന്യം നീക്കം ചെയ്യൽ

about: Citizens and residents ask for collection of garden waste, furniture, appliances and other large household items.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

timing: An agreed time is arranged for putting the waste outside the house boundary
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app)
